races.name: Man Commercial Protection Novices' Handicap Chase (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
Tricky stuff, but KIWI DE COTTE has the potential to be better than his mark over fences and the dual point/hurdles winner can make a successful return to chasing.

  1. KIWI DE COTTE (FR)
  2. PASSENGERONTHESHIP (IRE)
  3. IN THE TRENCHES

races.name: Molson Coors Conditional Jockeys' Handicap Chase
races.verdict:
Not a strong handicap chase on paper and MALINAS GLORY could be the way to go as he looks on a good mark having been first past the post in a hunter here when last seen in the spring. Saint Arion makes a quick switch to fences for his in-form stable and may have found a good opening if leaving his previous form behind in first-time cheekpieces.

  1. MALINAS GLORY (IRE)
  2. SAINT ARION (IRE)
  3. BALLINOULART (IRE)

races.name: Jerroms Financial Group Novices' Hurdle (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
TRALEE GIRL made the most of a good opportunity when opening her account over hurdles at Sedgefield last week and could kick on now she's up and running. She can strike while the iron is hot and go in again, probably at the main expense of Sixpack, who can do better on his second go in this sphere.

  1. TRALEE GIRL (IRE)
  2. SIXPACK
  3. BATH TAVERNESS

races.name: Paul Ferguson's Jumpers To Follow Handicap Chase (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
FEVER DREAM tends to go well fresh and is probably still ahead of his mark back after a breathing operation so is chanced to add a second Warwick success to his tally. Ki Woo might be the one for the forecast.

  1. FEVER DREAM (IRE)
  2. KI WOO (FR)
  3. DUNKERQUE (DEN)

races.name: Zulus Gonna Get Ya Mares' Handicap Hurdle
races.verdict:
JAMMY JAY is taken to go one better than at Bangor last time and gain a deserved first win over hurdles at the chief expense of Guts And Glory who got off the mark comfortably at Stratford and rates a big threat going into handicaps. Ballylicky Bay appeals as the pick of the rest for minor honours.

  1. JAMMY JAY
  2. GUTS AND GLORY
  3. BALLYLICKY BAY (IRE)

races.name: Abi And Brad Divorce Handicap Hurdle
races.verdict:
LACRIMA wasn't at his best when fourth at Worcester in July but had looked good when an emphatic winner there the time before and is fancied to bounce back in style now freshened up after a break. The handily-weighted Back In The Bay could emerge as the chief threat back hurdling after being pulled up over fences at Bangor.

  1. LACRIMA (FR)
  2. BACK IN THE BAY (IRE)
  3. BELLES BENEFIT (IRE)

races.name: betting.bet Free Racing Tips Conditional Jockeys' Handicap Hurdle
races.verdict:
VIRTUAL ROCK defied big odds with a bit up his sleeve at Uttoxeter last week and looks capable of defying a penalty providing he continues to stand regular racing. Tilehurst has form figures of 12 since the cheekpieces went on and seems sure to give another good account.

  1. VIRTUAL ROCK (IRE)
  2. TILEHURST
  3. GOODWIN FACE (FR)

races.name: City Electrical Factors Handicap Chase (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
A case can be made for all 4 but a chance is taken on AMERICAN LAND, who goes back chasing from an exploitable mark on the back of a breathing operation. Lermoos Legend is in fine form so should be bang there again.

  1. AMERICAN LAND (IRE)
  2. LERMOOS LEGEND
  3. TAPLEY

races.name: betting.bet New Betting Sites Juvenile Maiden Hurdle (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
OLLIEROB is in good hands and, with the standard set not at all high, he earns the tentative vote to make a successful debut, with the market likely to offer further clues. Rum Diamond can put his experience to use and is feared most.

  1. OLLIEROB (IRE)
  2. RUM DIAMOND
  3. JANTELOVEN (IRE)

races.name: Setford Handicap Hurdle
races.verdict:
Fitted with cheekpieces for the first time over hurdles, STARSHINE LEGEND produced a big career best when successful at Worcester a month ago and with this further increase in trip in his favour, he can go in again. Getaway With You is back on his last winning mark so he's a big threat, with course specialist Motazzen also of interest given his course record.

  1. STARSHINE LEGEND (IRE)
  2. GETAWAY WITH YOU
  3. MOTAZZEN (IRE)

races.name: betting.bet Play Champion Tipster Handicap Chase (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
FLASHY BOY would have completed a quick-fire Newton Abbot double last week had he not made a couple of bad mistakes and clearly thriving from his low base, he makes lots of appeal. This represents a drop in class for Yes Day and he's the obvious alternative.

  1. FLASHY BOY (IRE)
  2. YES DAY (IRE)
  3. BALLYNAHEER (IRE)

races.name: betting.bet Free Bets Novices' Limited Handicap Hurdle
races.verdict:
Hard to make a compelling case for any of these but a visor may well sharpen LUCKY IN TAIPAN up and he looks capable of winning a small race for Ben Pauling. Lady Fortune has already tasted success and a short break may well have done her some good, with Winston's Oath a possible improver given the yard he represents.

  1. LUCKY IN TAIPAN (IRE)
  2. LADY FORTUNE (IRE)
  3. WINSTON'S OATH (IRE)

races.name: Churchill Tyres Apprentice Handicap
races.verdict:
SNOOKER MCCREW had a bit to spare when an all-the-way winner at Kempton last week and might be able to defy the penalty. Tiberio Force is respected on the back of his Ripon classified win, while an unexposed profile provides hope that Star Suepreme may build on last week's course success.

  1. SNOOKER MCCREW
  2. TIBERIO FORCE
  3. STAR SUEPREME

races.name: Old Gravel Pits Lodges EBF Novice Stakes (GBB/GBBPlus Race)
races.verdict:
ARTHURIAN sets a tall standard judged on his third in listed company at Haydock 17 days ago and looks the way to go returned to calmer waters. Bayraktar appeals as the lead danger following his York debut second, whilst Austin looks sure to build on his opening run at Haydock.

  1. ARTHURIAN
  2. BAYRAKTAR (IRE)
  3. AUSTIN

races.name: Christmas Parties R Us Restricted Novice Stakes (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
If CALL ME TOMORROW can recapture the pick of her early-season form back from a break she may ensure that Star People has to settle for the runner-up spot yet again. Muve On looks best of the remainder.

  1. CALL ME TOMORROW (IRE)
  2. STAR PEOPLE (FR)
  3. MUVE ON

races.name: Eddie And Violet Smith Conditions Stakes (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
JM JUNGLE has run well in a Group 1 in Ireland since his win in the Bullet here last month and is preferred to Jakajaro, who will be a major threat to the selection if near his best but has been below par the last twice.

  1. JM JUNGLE (IRE)
  2. JAKAJARO (IRE)
  3. TOCA MADERA (IRE)

races.name: John Allinson 90th Birthday Handicap
races.verdict:
BATTENBURG BELLE has thrived in recent weeks, taking her form up a notch on the back of a sharp exit from the stalls when scoring again at Catterick (6f) 2 weeks ago. She looks a big player in her hat-trick bid from a 5 lb higher mark. Black Missile and Under The Radar can give her most to think about.

  1. BATTENBURG BELLE (IRE)
  2. BLACK MISSILE (IRE)
  3. UNDER THE RADAR (IRE)

races.name: Fango Handicap (Div 1)
races.verdict:
MISUNDERSTOOD is taken to gain reward for a couple of recent near misses, including over C&D. The hat-trick seeking Supreme Clarets heads the dangers along with Count Palatine and lightly-raced 3-y-o Cotai Eye Joe.

  1. MISUNDERSTOOD (FR)
  2. SUPREME CLARETS (IRE)
  3. COUNT PALATINE (IRE)

races.name: Fango Handicap (Div 2)
races.verdict:
The likeable and consistent TATTIE BOGLE might be able to defy a 4 lb rise for a Brighton success at the start of the month. Glenfinnan's C&D form figures this year are 121 and he's feared most ahead of Folkene and Style of Life.

  1. TATTIE BOGLE
  2. GLENFINNAN (IRE)
  3. FOLKENE (FR)

races.name: End Of Season Handicap
races.verdict:
HORWICH's consistency tempers enthusiasm but he went like the best horse at the weights when splitting Dalamara and Amber Hamur at Musselburgh 2 starts back and with his latest Wolverhampton run easily overlooked, he could well represent a spot of value. The latter rival may emerge as the chief threat, ahead of Bath scorer Buckland Belle. Dalamara also commands respect in an open-looking finale.

  1. HORWICH
  2. AMBER HAMUR (IRE)
  3. BUCKLAND BELLE

races.name: Weekend Winners On At The Races Maiden Stakes (GBB/GBBPlus Race)
races.verdict:
FLIGHT TRACKER is from a smart family and has made a positive start to his career this summer. He can get off the mark. Likely improvers My Boy and Anahona are feared most.

  1. FLIGHT TRACKER
  2. MY BOY (IRE)
  3. ANAHONA (USA)

races.name: attheraces.com/marketmovers Handicap (Div 1)
races.verdict:
LONDONER remains fairly treated and arrives on the back of a good second at Wolverhampton earlier this month. He makes fair appeal. Darn Hot Gallop and Kalokalo can also make their presence felt.

  1. LONDONER (IRE)
  2. DARN HOT GALLOP
  3. KALOKALO (IRE)

races.name: attheraces.com/marketmovers Handicap (Div 2)
races.verdict:
This can go to HOT AND COLD, who returned to winning ways over C&D earlier this month and hasn't been harshly treated by the handicapper for that victory. Winston's Warrior and Assiri Heights may provide the chief threat.

  1. HOT AND COLD
  2. WINSTON'S WARRIOR (IRE)
  3. ASSIRI HEIGHTS (IRE)

races.name: Follow AtTheRaces On X Restricted Maiden Fillies' Stakes (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
NEWS is bred to be useful and could be up to making a winning debut for her top yard. Ma Blushin Rosie made her effort earlier than ideal at Thirsk last time and is worth another chance to build on her initial promise, while Connie Sachs and Keithaar are other newcomers to keep an eye on in the betting.

  1. NEWS (IRE)
  2. MA BLUSHIN ROSIE (IRE)
  3. CONNIE SACHS

races.name: Download The At The Races App Fillies' Handicap
races.verdict:
Preference is for INSIDE STORY, who has upped her game of late and didn't get the clearest of runs when second at Wolverhampton last month. Afraj and Merry rate the principal dangers.

  1. INSIDE STORY (IRE)
  2. AFRAJ (IRE)
  3. MERRY

races.name: Sky Sports Racing Sky 415 Handicap
races.verdict:
Not as competitive as the numbers suggest and KOFFEE AND KALE looks to have found a very good opportunity to gain a first win of 2026 on the back of an improved recent Wolverhampton second. The reliable My Mate Mackley is next on the list in his bid for a third victory ahead of in-form duo Long Shot and Deadline.

  1. KOFFEE AND KALE
  2. MY MATE MACKLEY
  3. LONG SHOT

races.name: Free Tips Daily On attheraces.com Handicap
races.verdict:
A case can be made for a few of these but LAST FLIGHT is on the up since sent over staying distances and can defy a 3 lb weights rise and follow up her maiden Ffos Las success. Fabled Spirit rates a big threat though on the back of her breakthrough Lingfield success, while both Sir Griflet and Edwardtheninth can play a prominent role too.

  1. LAST FLIGHT
  2. FABLED SPIRIT (IRE)
  3. SIR GRIFLET (IRE)

races.name: Free Bets On attheraces.com Handicap
races.verdict:
MANAGING DIRECTOR didn't enjoy the rub of the green in a big field at York last time and is taken to capitalise on a handy-looking mark here. Hanney Girl is feared most on the back of her very good Catterick second, while the returning duo of Courageous Sioux and Dance Of Angels both bring potential on their handicap debuts and also need factoring into this open handicap.

  1. MANAGING DIRECTOR (IRE)
  2. HANNEY GIRL
  3. COURAGEOUS SIOUX

races.name: Weekend Winners On At The Races Handicap (GBBPlus Race)
races.verdict:
GOLDEN KNIGHT didn't enjoy the rub of the green when third at Newbury last time and with this return to a longer trip also a positive he looks the way to go in this competitive handicap. C&D scorer Cliff Danger can also go well on his first run for Tom Ellis, while the returning duo Solarize and Urchin remain with potential and could play a part too.

  1. GOLDEN KNIGHT (IRE)
  2. CLIFF DANGER
  3. SOLARIZE

races.name: SIS Irish EBF Maiden
races.verdict:
SPEAKERS CORNER clearly didn't give his running despite having the worst of the draw at Glorious Goodwood 52 days ago and with his debut effort at the Curragh previously a promising one, he's fancied to bounce back with first-time blinkers now enlisted. Loughrea N Roll following his very good debut third looks a big threat though, with Churchill Bond also fancied to feature.

  1. SPEAKERS CORNER (IRE)
  2. LOUGHREA N ROLL (IRE)
  3. CHURCHILL BOND

races.name: Rose Hotel Handicap (0-60)
races.verdict:
Lots with chances but IMPERIAL DREAM rates the pick of the weights on the back of a resurgent Galway second so edges the vote. Sand Art gained a breakthrough success at Sligo last time and rates a big threat with that form having been well advertised since. Both She's On The Ball and Sceitimini can also play a prominent role. Cisterna completes the shortlist.

  1. IMPERIAL DREAM (IRE)
  2. SAND ART (IRE)
  3. SHE'S ON THE BALL (IRE)

races.name: WTW Willis Towers Watson Handicap
races.verdict:
Perhaps this is the day APACHE OUTLAW finally snaps his losing run. Like the selection, Mercurial hasn't tasted success since 2024 but he's recorded 2 good placed efforts in his last 3 starts. Last year's winner Dragon of Malta is once again bidding for successive victories, and a third in this race in 4 years, having scored here on Monday.

  1. APACHE OUTLAW (IRE)
  2. MERCURIAL (IRE)
  3. DRAGON OF MALTA (IRE)

races.name: Edmund & Josie Whelan Memorial Listowel Stakes (Listed)
races.verdict:
JAGGED EDGE might be able to give the weight away and land a second successive listed win. Meriden is another who has already won at listed level this season and is second choice ahead of Chica Guerrera, who has been performing well enough in handicaps to think she can make an impact at this higher level.

  1. JAGGED EDGE (IRE)
  2. MERIDEN
  3. CHICA GUERRERA (IRE)

races.name: MAC Hardware & Farm Supplies Irish EBF Rated Race
races.verdict:
ROMANCE had plenty to spare in a nursery last time and might be able to follow up. Banks of The Boyne is exposed but has proved consistent and may provide the chief threat ahead of Aidan O'Brien's Oklahoma.

  1. ROMANCE (GER)
  2. BANKS OF THE BOYNE (IRE)
  3. OKLAHOMA (USA)

races.name: Listowel Arms Hotel Handicap
races.verdict:
GLYNDWR had been shaping well until not at his best at Laytown last time and is fancied to bounce back in style off a handy-looking mark wth headgear (both 2025 wins in cheekpieces) going on for the first time this season. Adrian McGuinness saddles three and his Goal Exceeded could prove the pick in his bid for a third win of 2026. Morehampton and Highbury See See also need factoring in.

  1. GLYNDWR (IRE)
  2. GOAL EXCEEDED
  3. MOREHAMPTON (IRE)

races.name: Jet, Peggy & Eamonn O'Carroll Memorial Handicap
races.verdict:
An interesting 3-y-o handicap to conclude the card with the vote going to top weight COUNT BEZUKHOV, who has some solid form and there may well be even more to come now that his stamina is drawn out further. Sunrush is unexposed at the trip and can go well again, with Huff'n'puff completing the shortlist.

  1. COUNT BEZUKHOV (IRE)
  2. SUNRUSH (IRE)
  3. HUFF'N'PUFF

races.name: 4Racing Welcomes You Maiden Plate
races.verdict:
BERRY LANCER could be the way to go. Shining Star is another who could play a big role in proceedings, while Chancellor is the third candidate for the three.

  1. BERRY LANCER (SAF)
  2. SHINING STAR (SAF)
  3. CHANCELLOR (SAF)

races.name: Racing240 Maiden Plate (F & M)
races.verdict:
TREASURE STATE could be worth chancing. Satisfied also has claims, while Piteraq is in with a shout.

  1. TREASURE STATE (SAF)
  2. SATISFIED (SAF)
  3. PITERAQ (SAF)

races.name: www.tab.co.za Fm 89 Divided Handicap (F & M)
races.verdict:
FIRE IN HER SOUL can land the spoils. Beautiful Rania makes most appeal of the others, ahead of Winds Of Grace.

  1. FIRE IN HER SOUL (SAF)
  2. BEAUTIFUL RANIA (SAF)
  3. WINDS OF GRACE (SAF)

races.name: Tab Telebet 011 074 0300 Maiden Plate
races.verdict:
BE THE ONE should make a bold show. Giddy Up Grace is another player, with Madrid having real place claims.

  1. BE THE ONE (SAF)
  2. GIDDY UP GRACE (SAF)
  3. MADRID (SAF)

races.name: Play Soccer 6, 10 And 13 Maiden Plate
races.verdict:
ONE EYE ON DUBAI has obvious claims. Verdandi gets the nod among the others, although Clairwood Breeze is another that could go well.

  1. ONE EYE ON DUBAI (NZ)
  2. VERDANDI (SAF)
  3. CLAIRWOOD BREEZE (SAF)

races.name: Betway Pinnacle Stakes
races.verdict:
BELLEROPHON looks set to win again. Positive Attitude is second choice, while Hotarubi can fight it out for minor honours.

  1. BELLEROPHON (SAF)
  2. POSITIVE ATTITUDE (SAF)
  3. HOTARUBI (SAF)

races.name: youcanbetonus! Mr 83 Handicap
races.verdict:
SHERIFF BILL BROWN is improving and can win again. Lone Horizon looks sure to be involved, while Palace Attack could do better again.

  1. SHERIFF BILL BROWN (SAF)
  2. LONE HORIZON (SAF)
  3. PALACE ATTACK (SAF)

races.name: For Hospitality Bookings Call 011 681 1796 Middle Stakes
races.verdict:
SHE'S ALL MINE could be worth chancing. Cold Shine is a danger, while Antonio Gaudi is also in the running.

  1. SHE'S ALL MINE (SAF)
  2. COLD SHINE (SAF)
  3. ANTONIO GAUDI (SAF)

races.name: Next Vaal Racemeeting Thursday 1 October Fm 69 Divided Handicap (F & M)
races.verdict:
HIGHWAY HEIRESS has more to come and can win again. Me And You must be in the equation, while Apostrophe is not out of it for the place money.

  1. HIGHWAY HEIRESS (SAF)
  2. ME AND YOU (SAF)
  3. APOSTROPHE (SAF)

races.name: Prix De Puy Guillaume Maiden Stakes
Prix De La Source De L'hopital Claiming Stakes
Prix The Fellow - Marquise De Moratalla Chase (Grade 3)
Prix Richard Et Robert Hennessy Chase (Grade 3)
